name: Meisya
source:
Performing Arts major; Ginger cat

A self-proclaimed thieving feline who claims to have stolen every test paper she's tried for.

A cat girl who always gives advance notice for any performance she's going to show for. She gets rather disappointed when they don't go to plan.
